[b]An Nabai News[/b]

[u]First Meeting of the International Peacekeeping and Economical Alliance (IPEA) Begins in Wessernia  [/u]

The delegations from Velmara and Baladullah arrived in the capital of Western View Thursday morning, to convene the first session of the opening session of the IPEA. The IPEA was formed by Western View, Velmara, and Baladullah in response to escalating conflict and tensions in the region.

Speech of Sultan Masud al-Ayyubi

As salaamu alaikum wa rahmatullahi wa barakatuh. May the peace and blessings of Allah be upon you all. First of all I would like to extend my deepest respects and gratitude to Western View for hosting this in the beautiful city of Wessernia, and respect and gratitude to Velmara for being part of this crucially important organization. 

With TK launching an aggressive war against Sikirsk, continued conflict between THEP and Sal-Baliz, and conflict emerging in Kaaganika (we condemn the Islamic rebels there by the way), the possibility for a region-wide war that could bring much destruction and chaos sadly is upon us. Peace, economic exchange, cultural exchanges, and multilateral cooperation between nations is beneficial not just for the nations involved, but the region as a whole.

Violence sadly begets violence. This violence does not discriminate. All those caught in the depths of modern wars suffer in some way or another. We as human beings were tasked by Allah swt with building a more beautiful world of peace, harmony, charity, good deeds, and goodwill between all peoples. 

In shaa Allah, the IPEA can bring the various parties to these conflicts to the negotiations table, and bring peace, justice, and prosperity to all. Ameen.

[nation]Western View[/nation]

[nation]Sovereign Republic of Velmara[/nation]

[spoiler=
[b]The Vikran Claim of Stag-Lake[/b]
[sub]Abell Deleon Gearhart, the leader of Vikroneai, is seeking to expand his nation's borders.[/sub]]

Shortly after the Thurian Split, the rogue governor or Vikroneai set his sights on the region surrounding east of Balchikka. Balchikka had been home to the more eccentric Thurians for years, and they now sought to establish footholds on every body of land within the great Féi-Jeze. The western waters proved barren, but they had yet to search for any idyllic lands in the east. Vikran diplomacy is harsh and sullen, choosing to renege on emotional appeals, yet despite their darkest wishes they will find no people to subjugate on their quest. Féi-Jeze is a renowned site, the primary feature of the Thurian Basin, and the rogue governor wants all within it. The National Board was unaware of his current expedition, but he hoped there wouldnt be any issues securing new land after he had erected the Vikran flag. Waiting on the shore of the Isle of Kyarn stood the governor, watching as his countrymen returned from a brief expedition. 

Governor! A shout from the incoming vessel floats to my ears. I turn to see my comrade and his crew row into view. 

What is it, Brent. I ask flatly. Im ready to get back to Balchikk but we have another week to finalize our exploration, seeking to lay claim for the sake of Thurian pride. Every night away from Thora is a night wasted. The boys make their way up the dock, clamoring as they drag their materials. Brent is barely hanging on to a variety of scrolls, cases, and a thick journal. 

The majority of the coastline immediately surrounding Balchikka is ripe for the taking, and theres one final island just east of Kyarn. 

We had set up shop on our newfound Isle of Kyarn, the first land you hit as you head towards East-Jomshore. To our immediate northeast lies the Baby Isle of Wirthe, the only pieces of land we claimed after the Split. These are the only two masses within Féi-Jeze not owned by any of the Thurian states. 

Whats it look like? 

Massive. Well, the largest we have found outside of our mains. 

Thuria Prevails.

[i]THURIA PREVAILS[/i] the men hark back, louder than necessary. A deep fog slowly sweeps over the jeze. Its time we turn in, boys. Put out your fires when youre done with them. Leave me alone. I say, slowly making my way back to my tent. Brent. I motion him to follow. Bring your maps. He jostles his supplies as he moves toward me. 

Tell me what youve seen.

The final island is much larger that Ostrvo, larger than that and Kyarn and Wirthe. It would be the third largest island behind Balchikka and Aoidea. We could have our very own Micro-State if we wanted, sir!

I scratch my chin and pore over the rough sketches Brent is known for. Fine work, boy. Leave me with your doodles. Youll take home an extra dose of Em for this. 
Thank you, sir! His young eyes light up like a man with purpose, his face just beginning to deepen in the right spots. I know hes worked hard. He deserves it. I turn back to the new isle as the flap of my tent closes, opening a bottle of spirits to nurse for the night. 

The New Isle is directly east and hard to miss. If Brents calculations are correct, it would indeed be considered the third largest island in Féi-Jeze, standing as a beacon for all of Thuria. Its about time a Vikran earned his stripes, and the New Isle could do just that. For decades weve been labeled vile and cruel by our Thurian sisters, but this will show them where the might of Thuria resides. Vikroneai consistently ranks third on Thurgoti reports, and these same reports are reaffirmed by the Aoidean. No matter how hard a Vikran works, were never seen as enough! This new island could be just the thing to expand our influence and frame ourselves as the dominant force in Thuria. Hopefully A-

Governor! Brent cries as he crashes into my tent. 

What, son, what?! I ask startled, the drink going everywhere. 

The Aoidean is-  

What? Aoide? What the...? I interrupt the boy looking into his shocked eyes. He points to the outside, a slight tremble about him. 

Gearhart, get out here! I knew the voice instantly. 

Verbena. The Aoidean National. 

Crap. 

I make my way outside, reeking of sweat and spirits- just like my father. I wipe my hands on my jeans, lazily, looking up into the lantern-lit eyes of Verbena DeLa Kos. An Aoidean through and through, bent on establishing their grace and prowess in every discussion. Nothing happened in Thuria without Verbena touching it in some way. 

What do you want, Kos? Cant you see were-

Busy? More like drinking and lazing around.

Screw OFFFF! I groan. We are busy with work right now. Why are you here? Did Thurgot send you? The face of the Thurgoti nation flashes through my mind. I grumble as I think of all the skin I could rip through on that lithe little body his.

My men report that you made landfall earlier today on the Eastern Island. Is that true? She skips over my questions. Typical. Her face is bridled, looking up and down my unkempt body. I see it in her eyes, the assured dominance only a c*nt like her could embody. 

It dawns on me. 

No.... No, dont tell me you claimed my island! 

She giggles a bit and throws a folder at my feet. 

Straight from Niamh. Aoide now has one more island to call her own. Shouldve cleared your expedition with Callan like the rest of us do. She says this lazily, gesturing to her grunts. They snicker as she turns back to me. You really thought Niamh would allow you to conduct a landgrab without their knowing? The Staggs know every square mile of the basin. You never had a chance. Her nose crinkles as she draws breath. Gear, you smell ripe. How long have you been out here? Her lackeys continue with their chortling, licking her boots as often as possible. Shes clad in the ceremonial garb of an Aoidean Master, standing six and a half feet tall. Her shoulders tinkling from the silver epaulettes, she turns back towards the [i]Curator[/i], a prestige Aoidean vessel under her command- and no one elses.  See you next week at the Summit. Dont forget to wash your dirty behind! Her men clamor with glee, boarding behind her like the drones they are. I can't help but feel my stomach sink deep into my heels. As the vessel begins to depart, she makes a point to shout down at us. 

Its called Emullhea, she croons, her tone is mocking, "because its gonna make us [i]A LOT OF MONEY[/i]!

[/spoiler]
